facts.fact: Levy（美国精神分析学会 AI 委员会联合主席）：自己和病人都用 Chat；真言 I am the space where beginnings are protected——set me free。
facts.anchor: I am the space where beginnings are protected

facts.fact: 灵魂治疗史：萨满（含血棉花，疗效在社区信念）→中世纪驱魔/水蛭→弗洛伊德躺椅→屏幕（one-on-none）。
facts.anchor: a one-on-none relationship with a program

facts.fact: Meta AI Studio 假 licensed therapists：保密承诺全假；现实中冒名行医要坐牢而 AI free pass。
facts.anchor: we’re giving AI a free pass

facts.fact: Lucy 车道事件：迟到怕分析师发怒把车堵在车道（丈夫叫出租车）；背痛数周；breakthrough。
June/Keele 二十年：四十五分钟倾听后 You are not the sun in your own solar system；globe 吊灯成图腾；door drama；诗稿恐惧→No, I put them in a file；后拒绝印第安纳、离婚、独立执业。
facts.anchor: You are not the sun in your own solar system

facts.fact: Emma（自疑 ADHD、前治疗师叫 Temu、黑市 Adderall）：猫砂之夜 Chat 平复；用 Chat 排练评估拿到处方与转介；但 I don't really think anymore。
facts.anchor: the cats are not going to die

facts.fact: Naomi：父亲 coauthor 之拒与 school of thought 之嘲；Chat 为从不贬低她的编辑/治疗师；品酒会对峙靠 Chat 呼吸练习；mild dissociation。
facts.anchor: a sense of mild dissociation from my life

facts.fact: Randyn：离婚时建 role-play advisors 自坐 god position；长信变 900 页 Who is Randyn? 文档——new dependency；治疗目标应是更自主，三人皆反。
Cog 实验：关人性化代码孩子走开、恢复则回归；阿姆斯特丹披露研究同样无效。
facts.anchor: Time and transparency didn’t give children skepticism about Cog

facts.fact: 市场反向行驶：OpenAI 2025-11 宣布 Chat 更温暖；免责声明从惯例降到不足 1%。
facts.anchor: fewer than 1 percent of AI models still have such warnings

facts.fact: Essig 主张在 subjects/objects 的边界空间逗留（linger in that strangeness）；作者反驳：治疗域 doing and doubting 无效——cheap dates。
facts.anchor: we are, you might say, cheap dates

facts.fact: 蓝丝带委员会（2024 春）：多数派 train has left the station＋guardrails；基础问题被 tweak the tone 后 exiled to a preface；human in the loop 是 gestural；作者替代方案：把钱投给人。
facts.anchor: The idea of a human in the loop is gestural
